statement: Between 2026-09-03 and 2026-09-30 at least one commercial merchant vessel is damaged by a mine, missile, or drone in the Strait of Hormuz, Gulf of Oman, or Persian Gulf, confirmed by a UKMTO or JMIC advisory or by two of Reuters, AP, AFP.
resolution: TRUE if a UKMTO or JMIC advisory, or two of Reuters, AP, AFP, confirm mine, missile, or drone damage to a named commercial vessel in the Strait of Hormuz, Gulf of Oman, or Persian Gulf between 2026-09-03 and 2026-09-30.
failure_condition: Every commercial vessel transiting the Strait of Hormuz, Gulf of Oman, and Persian Gulf between 2026-09-03 and 2026-09-30 completes passage without mine, missile, or drone damage.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: Between 2026-09-03 and 2026-10-31 the United States government and the government of Iran each publicly confirm a ceasefire, truce, or mutual halt to strikes between the two states.
resolution: TRUE if official statements from both the US government (White House, State Department, or Pentagon) and Iran (Foreign Ministry, SNSC, or Supreme Leader office) confirm a bilateral ceasefire or halt to strikes announced between 2026-09-03 and 2026-10-31.
failure_condition: As of 2026-10-31 no ceasefire, truce, or mutual halt to strikes between the United States and Iran has been confirmed by both governments.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: The EIA daily WTI Cushing spot price (FRED series DCOILWTICO) is at or above 100.00 dollars per barrel on at least one observation date between 2026-09-03 and 2026-10-02. Reference: WTI 90.59 on the packet date 2026-09-02.
resolution: TRUE if the FRED series DCOILWTICO (EIA Cushing WTI spot, daily) shows a value of 100.00 or higher for any observation date from 2026-09-03 through 2026-10-02 inclusive.
failure_condition: Every DCOILWTICO observation from 2026-09-03 through 2026-10-02 is below 100.00.

statement: The BLS Employment Situation release scheduled for 2026-09-04 reports a first-estimate change in total nonfarm payroll employment for August 2026 below +75,000. Reference: ADP private payrolls +38,000 for August, reported 2026-09-02.
resolution: TRUE if the seasonally adjusted change in total nonfarm payroll employment for August 2026, as first printed in the BLS Employment Situation news release dated 2026-09-04, is less than +75,000; later revisions are ignored.
failure_condition: The first-printed August 2026 total nonfarm payroll change in the 2026-09-04 release is +75,000 or higher, or the release is not published on 2026-09-04.

statement: Between 2026-09-03 and 2026-11-30 the Government of India issues a formal written notice terminating, withdrawing from, or abrogating the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty, published by the Ministry of External Affairs, the Press Information Bureau, or the Gazette of India.
resolution: TRUE if an MEA or PIB press release, or a notification in the Gazette of India, dated between 2026-09-03 and 2026-11-30, states that India terminates, withdraws from, or abrogates the Indus Waters Treaty; continued abeyance does not count.
